articles.title: DVAC books DMK leader Duraimurugan in Rs 1,427 cr illegal sand mining scam
articles.description: The DVAC has registered an FIR against senior DMK leader Duraimurugan for illegal sand mining activities. Several officials and private contractors are also implicated in this scam. This illegal mining has reportedly caused a massive loss of Rs 1,427.34 crore to the state exchequer. The accused manipulated tenders and fabricated documents to facilitate their wrongdoing.

articles.title: Himachal Pradesh Holds Vendor Development Programme To Link MSMEs With Large Industries
articles.description: Himachal Pradesh Holds Vendor Development Programme To Link MSMEs With Large Industries Shimla, Nov 17 (KNN) A Vendor Development Programme (VDP) was organised at the Himachal Chamber of Commerce and Industry (HCCI), Paonta Sahib, under the Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance (RAMP) Scheme to strengthen business linkages between large industries and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs). The programme was organised with the support of the Union Ministry of MSME and the Himachal Pradesh Department of Industries, in collaboration with Tinge Consultancy Pvt. Ltd. and Wonder Worx. Focus on Procurement and Market Access Representatives from the pharmaceutical, packaging, food processing and engineering sectors were briefed on procurement procedures, quality standards, technology upgradation, supply-chain integration, credit facilities and government support schemes. The sessions also covered vendor registration with large corporations, tendering procedures, documentation requirements, the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal and market linkages. A buyer-seller interaction session involving Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Original Product Manufacturers (OPMs) provided entrepreneurs an opportunity to explore business partnerships and connect with large industrial buyers. Vendors also showcased their products at an exhibition. Experts encouraged MSMEs to improve product quality, upgrade technology and strengthen their business capabilities to become part of the supply chains of larger industries. (KNN Bureau)
